HomePage.title: multo — Next.js starter
HomePage.description: Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, next-intl, Zustand, TanStack Query, and React Hook Form are wired up and ready to go.

TechStack.title: Tech stack
TechStack.nextjs: App Router with Turbopack and React Compiler enabled.
TechStack.typescript: Strict mode with typed routes and translations.
TechStack.shadcn: Accessible UI primitives, owned as source code.
TechStack.nextIntl: Locale routing and translations for English and Japanese.
TechStack.tanstackQuery: Server state, caching, and data fetching with devtools.
TechStack.reactHookForm: Performant, uncontrolled forms with minimal re-renders.
TechStack.zod: Schema-first validation shared across client and server.
TechStack.t3env: Type-safe environment variables validated with Zod.
TechStack.nextThemes: Dark mode and theme switching without flashes.

Features.title: Features
Features.i18nRouting: English served at / and Japanese at /ja
Features.envValidation: Environment variables validated at build time
Features.linting: Fast linting and formatting with oxlint and oxfmt
Features.commits: Conventional commits enforced with husky and commitlint
Features.csp: Content Security Policy and security headers preconfigured
